name: io.github.adamson-gh/localsig
title: LocalSig - Local Outage Guidance
description: Maryland power outages, weather alerts, water notices and grid alerts by county, with what to do.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Power outages, weather alerts, water notices and grid alerts for one Maryland county right now, each with what to do, its source and link. status is 'all clear', 'heads up', 'act now' or 'can't tell' (a source could not be read). Use this for 'is the power out in X', 'anything I should know in X county', 'is it safe to ...'.

county.description: A Maryland county or Baltimore City, e.g. 'Montgomery', 'Prince George's', 'Baltimore City'

tools.name: get_zip
tools.description: How many customers are without power in one Maryland ZIP code right now (State of Maryland data). For weather and water, call get_signals with the county.

tools.name: list_counties
tools.description: All 24 Maryland areas (23 counties and Baltimore City) with the share of customers without power right now and a level: ok, notable or major.

tools.name: get_advice
tools.description: LocalSig's general advice for an event: power (before it goes out), power_out (once yours is out), tornado, flood, wind, winter, heat, cold, water_boil, water_essential, water_out, grid.
